# Macrofold documentation

> Persistent agents on Macrofold Cloud or your own infrastructure. Start with Build with AI or the API quickstart.

## Start here

- [Documentation](docs/README.md): Start an agent task, review its output, and keep its files on Cloud or your own deployment.
- [From one task to ongoing work](docs/getting-started/agent-work.md): Keep saved work between runs, reuse agent setup, and add automation only when you need it.
- [Build with AI](docs/getting-started/agents.md): Give your coding agent a setup prompt and direct links to current Macrofold documentation.
- [API quickstart](docs/features/api/quickstart.md): Create a workspace and stream your first API-triggered run.
- [MCP for coding agents](docs/features/mcp/README.md): Configure shared agents and start cloud runs directly from Codex, Claude Code, or another MCP client.
- [Quickstart](docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): Create a workspace, start an agent, and review its saved work.
- [Core concepts](docs/getting-started/concepts.md): Start with a workspace, agent, and run; understand files, conversations, and compute separately.

## Integration paths

- [Customer agents](docs/features/customer-agents/README.md): Optional customer-specific setup over core workspaces, worktrees, presets, runs and connections.
- [Customer-agent quickstart](docs/features/customer-agents/quickstart.md): Ensure a customer assistant, send messages and retrieve saved files through ownership-checked SDK methods.
- [Customer account connections](docs/features/customer-agents/connections.md): Embed capability choices, verified account consent, permission editing and disconnect in your app.
- [File memory starter](docs/features/customer-agents/memory.md): Install an optional editable memory and task convention.
- [Personal agent example](examples/personal-agent/README.md): Run a complete customer-isolated personal agent app and adapt its ownership, persistence and recovery boundaries.
- [Customer data recipes](examples/integrations/README.md): Connect Supabase, Prisma, Pinecone or a customer-scoped MCP server with runnable local fixtures.

## Cloud and self-hosting

- [Macrofold Cloud](docs/cloud/README.md): Connect to the managed service and start building without operating infrastructure.
- [Self-hosting](docs/operations/README.md): Understand the hosting components and choose a deployment guide.
- [Execution tracing](docs/features/observability/README.md): Inspect model calls, customer context, token usage and costs in a private Langfuse tracing workspace.

## Build with the API

- [API overview](docs/features/api/README.md): Connect your application, start an agent, and retrieve its finished work.
- [SDKs](docs/features/api/sdks/README.md): Choose a Macrofold client for TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, or Java.
- [TypeScript SDK](sdk/typescript/README.md): Use typed requests and recoverable event streams in TypeScript.
- [Python SDK](sdk/python/README.md): Integrate runs and durable streams with the Python client.
- [Go SDK](sdk/go/README.md): Make typed API requests and stream agent progress in Go.
- [Rust SDK](sdk/rust/README.md): Make typed API requests and stream agent progress in Rust.
- [Java SDK](sdk/java/README.md): Make typed API requests and stream agent progress in Java.
- [Terminal CLI](docs/features/cli/README.md): Link a workspace, chat remotely, use worktrees, and transfer files.

## Guides

- [Dashboard](docs/features/dashboard/README.md): Navigate workspaces, files, run history, access, and usage.
- [Runs and agents](docs/features/execution/README.md): Select a harness, follow progress, continue work, and cancel safely.
- [Warm sandboxes and servers](docs/features/execution/sandboxes.md): Reuse compute across runs, or create, pause, resume and destroy long-running servers.
- [Explicit-context decisions](docs/features/decisions/README.md): Submit typed decisions with explicit evidence and budgets, without a worktree.
- [Context and definitions](docs/features/decisions/context.md): Publish immutable evidence and reusable contracts with audience and retention boundaries.
- [Bounded agents and tasks](docs/features/decisions/tasks.md): Inspect granted evidence and coordinate decisions, investigations and application review.
- [Decision examples](examples/decisions/README.md): Adapt customer-exception and actor-decision contracts with unknown and stale evidence.
- [Agent harnesses](docs/features/execution/harnesses.md): Choose Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, or Pi for persistent cloud work.
- [Agent permissions](docs/features/execution/permissions.md): Restrict files and tools at the workspace, worktree and run level.
- [Model catalog](docs/features/execution/models.md): Choose built-in models, understand discovery and caching, and preserve accepted run prices.
- [Worktrees and Git](docs/features/workspaces/README.md): Persist files, create branches, restore checkpoints, and synchronize GitHub.
- [Share a worktree](docs/features/workspaces/shared-agents.md): Hand persisted files between agents and choose independent worktrees for parallel work.
- [Read persisted files](docs/features/workspaces/read-files.md): Retrieve complete saved file contents by path through HTTP or any Macrofold SDK.
- [Files and media](docs/features/media/README.md): Attach images and documents, preview saved media, and download agent deliverables.
- [Connections and access](docs/features/identity-integrations/README.md): Bring provider keys and grant agents access to applications and MCP tools.
- [Connector access rules](docs/features/identity-integrations/connection-access.md): Approve tools, configure workspace and preset permissions, and preview one-run access.
- [Named accounts](docs/features/identity-integrations/named-connections.md): Connect multiple accounts, select authentication in presets, and understand Claude subscription availability.
- [Connector directory](docs/features/identity-integrations/catalog.md): Browse application toolkits, native integrations, and custom MCP connection options.
- [Web search](docs/features/identity-integrations/web-search.md): Configure a search provider and understand search behavior and billing.
- [Triggers](docs/features/triggers/README.md): Start agents from Slack, incoming webhooks or recurring prompts.
- [Slack bots](docs/features/triggers/slack.md): Connect a Slack bot to a persistent workspace and reply to messages.
- [Incoming webhooks](docs/features/triggers/webhooks.md): Create authenticated incoming endpoints with safe event retries.
- [Scheduled tasks](docs/features/triggers/scheduled-tasks.md): Save recurring prompts with cron, timezones, history and run-now controls.
- [Billing and limits](docs/features/billing/README.md): Understand plans, concurrency, budgets, reserved credits, and retention.
- [Detailed billing usage](docs/features/billing/usage.md): Query itemized charges and model token usage by time, workspace, worktree, run, or customer.

## Reference

- [API conventions](docs/features/api/conventions.md): Authentication, idempotency, errors, pagination, and asynchronous operations.
- [Streaming and webhooks](docs/features/api/events.md): Reconnect to run events and verify reliable webhook delivery.
- [Model and agent streaming](docs/features/api/streaming.md): Understand current agent streams and the planned direct-model delta interface and support limits.
- [HTTP quickstart](docs/features/api/http-quickstart.md): Create a workspace and run using cURL, with explicit request identities and streaming.
- [SDK method reference](docs/features/api/sdks/reference.md): Find the resource method for every public operation in all five languages.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/getting-started/troubleshooting.md): Recover from setup failures, access errors, interrupted streams, and conflicting edits.

## Deploy and operate

- [Deploy on Vercel](docs/operations/launch-guide.md): Configure and deploy the application, database, storage, and native runtime.
- [Environment configuration](docs/operations/launch-environment.md): Keep local, runtime, and migration configuration separate.
- [PostgreSQL and Neon](docs/operations/neon.md): Configure restricted roles, connection pooling, migrations, and recovery.
- [Provider integrations](docs/operations/launch-integrations.md): Register models, tools, billing, storage, email, and GitHub.
- [Usage and operator reporting](docs/features/operations/README.md): Read activity, execution demand, account metrics, and management MCP reports.
- [Host long-running servers](docs/features/execution/sandboxes/operations.md): Configure disposable Render services and operate their lifecycle and compute budgets.

## Development

- [Run and test](docs/getting-started/local-development.md): Choose local simulation, real local Docker agents, or cloud staging, with clear availability and test boundaries.
- [Local simulation](docs/getting-started/local-development/simulation.md): Start the local app and worker, invoke the API, and test customer journeys without paid agent calls.
- [Local Docker agents](docs/getting-started/local-development/docker.md): Run agents through the local API with Docker, persistent files, and free protocol tests.
- [Cloud staging](docs/getting-started/local-development/cloud.md): Invoke real agents through a staging API and distinguish complete execution from provider-only tests.
- [Unified Harness Interface](docs/features/execution/unified-harness-interface.md): Contribute a native harness with the shared adapter contract, runtime integration, and deterministic tests.
